parameters.content:
🤖 Freelancer Invoice & Billing Automation

This workflow automatically:
• Generates a professional invoice number
• Calculates totals and taxes
• Creates a branded HTML invoice
• Converts it to a PDF
• Uploads the PDF to Google Drive
• Saves invoice records to Google Sheets
• Emails the invoice to the client

Phase 1:
✔ Invoice Generation
✔ PDF Creation
✔ Google Drive Storage
✔ Google Sheets Tracking
✔ Email Delivery

Phase 2:
• Payment Tracking
• Automatic Follow-up Reminders
• WhatsApp Notifications
• Payment Gateway Integration
• Invoice Analytics Dashboard
